summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo has lag and stuttering issues even on low graphics settings, likely due to insufficient VRAM or driver/BiOs issues.
detected_fault: Insufficient VRAM or driver/BiOs issues causing system instability
suggested_solution: Run the game in Developer Mode with Display FPS enabled and monitor system parameters and VRAM usage during gameplay, consider using DLSS or FSR for improved performance.
